planets.name: TOI-4010 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4010 with a 14.7-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-4010 d was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-4010. Its orbit and size follow Kunimoto et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
